channel.title: Claude Code Live Cheatsheet
channel.description: Auto-updating cheatsheet for Claude Code — keyboard shortcuts, commands, tips, and more.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.196 highlights
item.description:
• Streaming idle watchdog on by default; CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG=0 disables (v2.1.196)
  • ← opens agents view (changed from ←← double press) (v2.1.196)
  • Org/Role default models appear in /model when admins set one (v2.1.196)
  • Remote Control disabled for non-Anthropic ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (v2.1.196)
  • Background sessions survive process stop/restart/update (v2.1.196)
  • claude mcp list won't spawn untrusted .mcp.json servers (v2.1.196)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.196
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG: Set 0 to disable; 5-min idle abort+retry on by default for all providers
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] ←: Open agents view
~ [slash-commands] /model [model]: Switch model; Org/Role default when admin sets one (←→ effort, s = session only)
~ [workflows-tips] API key → no cloud: API key / non-Anthropic ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL disables RC, /schedule, MCP, notifications
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES

Full changelog

• Added support for organization default models — admins set it in the org console; it shows as "Org default" (or "Role default") in `/model` when you haven't picked one yourself
• Added readable default names for sessions at start, making them easier to identify and message
• Added clickable file attachments in chat — Cmd/Ctrl-click reveals the file in Finder/Explorer
• Security: `claude mcp list`/`get` no longer spawn `.mcp.json` servers that a repo self-approved via a committed `.claude/settings.json`; untrusted workspaces show `⏸ Pending approval`
• Fixed waking a background job permanently deleting its conversation and re-running the original prompt when the transcript probe misread a real transcript; the file is now set aside, never deleted
• Fixed the rate-limit warning flickering off and rate-limit telemetry being over-counted when multiple parallel requests were in flight at the moment a usage limit was hit
• Fixed duplicate recap lines after a background session's turn: a schema-rejected StructuredOutput attempt no longer renders alongside its retry
• Fixed PowerShell `git diff`/`git grep`, `egrep`/`fgrep`, and quoted search patterns containing `|` being reported as failures when they exit 1, matching Bash behavior
• Fixed multiple `claude agents` side panel issues: keyboard focus getting stuck when opening an agent, background jobs losing their subagent types on every open, and sessions showing incorrect status while actively running
• Fixed `claude agents --dangerously-skip-permissions` silently falling back to auto mode instead of showing the bypass disclaimer and applying bypass mode to spawned agents
• Fixed mid-turn crash recovery for Remote sessions — sessions interrupted by a server restart now auto-resume on the next worker
• Fixed sessions moved with `/cd` reappearing in the old directory's resume list after a non-graceful exit when the old path contained special characters
• Fixed `claude plugin validate` skipping local plugins whose source is "." and stopping after the first error class
• Fixed Esc Esc at an idle prompt not opening the rewind menu (regression); use Ctrl+C or Ctrl+X Ctrl+K to stop background agents
• Fixed MCP OAuth requesting the authorization server's full `scopes_supported` catalog when no scope is specified, causing `invalid_scope` failures on GitLab self-hosted and other enterprise IdPs
• Fixed `/context` showing 0 tokens for all tool groups on Bedrock
• Fixed `/deep-research` misreporting verifier failures as "all claims refuted" instead of `unverified`
• Fixed plugin dependency version pins not being honored when the marketplace was added as a local folder path backed by a git repo
• Fixed `claude agents` session status: completed rows no longer flip between "Done" and "Needs your input", stalled agents are now labeled "Needs attention", and results that mention a PR show a clickable link
• Fixed voice dictation swallowing spaces and spuriously starting a recording during very fast typing when voice mode is enabled
• Improved background session reliability: long-running commands and workflows now survive the session's process being stopped, restarted, or updated — including on Windows, where background shells are handed off instead of being killed
• Improved background agents: workers killed by a daemon restart are now automatically resumed from where they left off the next time the agents view opens
• Improved `/code-review` workflow: merged five cleanup finders into one, cutting token usage by roughly 25%
• Reduced per-frame rendering work in the terminal UI by skipping no-op subtree walks during streaming
• The streaming idle watchdog is now on by default for all providers — it aborts and retries when a response stream produces no events for 5 minutes. Set `CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG=0` to disable.
• Remote Control is now disabled when `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` points at a non-Anthropic host, matching the existing behavior under `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK`/`_VERTEX`/`_FOUNDRY`
• Changed opening the agents view from a foreground session to require a single `←` press instead of two, matching the behavior in background sessions

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.195
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS: Disable mouse click/drag/hover in fullscreen mode; wheel scroll still works
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.193
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] autoMode.classifyAllShell: Route all Bash/PowerShell commands through auto-mode classifier
+ [config-env] OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES: 1=log assistant responses in OTEL; 0=keep prompts-only; unset follows OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP: Set to 1 to disable automatic memory-pressure reaping of idle bg shells
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] !: Direct bash; file path autocomplete; Claude responds to output
- [config-env] teammateMode: "iterm2"
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_TOOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.191
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

~ [slash-commands] /rewind: Rewind conv / code checkpoint; resume from before /clear (/undo alias)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.187
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] sandbox.credentials: Block sandboxed commands from reading credential files and secret env vars
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_TOOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT: Override 5-min idle timeout for remote MCP tool calls
~ [config-env] ANTHROPIC_MODEL: Default model; org restrictions can override
~ [slash-commands] /btw <question>: Side question (no context); ←/→ step through earlier answers
- [config-env] awsAuthRefresh
- [config-env] attribution.sessionUrl

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.186
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [mcp-servers] claude mcp login <name>: Authenticate MCP server from CLI; --no-browser for SSH
+ [mcp-servers] claude mcp logout <name>: Revoke MCP server authentication from CLI
+ [config-env] teammateMode: "iterm2": Use iTerm2 backend for agent teams; warns if it2 CLI missing
+ [config-env] respondToBashCommands: false keeps ! bash output as context only (default: Claude responds)
+ [config-env] awsAuthRefresh: Adds AWS credential refresh option to /login (managed)
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES: Max API retries (caps at 15); use RETRY_WATCHDOG for unattended
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG: Alternative retry cap for unattended/headless sessions
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] !: Direct bash; Claude responds to output (respondToBashCommands: false disables)
~ [slash-commands] /workflows: View dynamic workflow runs; press f to filter status
- [config-env] language
- [config-env] enforceAvailableModels
- [config-env] allowManagedHooksOnly
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.183
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] attribution.sessionUrl: Omit claude.ai session link from commits and PRs in web/RC sessions
~ [slash-commands] /config: Open settings; key=value sets any setting; --help lists shorthand keys
- [config-env] footerLinksRegexes

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.181
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] sandbox.allowAppleEvents: Opt-in: let sandboxed commands send Apple Events on macOS
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE: Marker file to suppress push notifications while at the machine
~ [slash-commands] /config: Open settings; key=value sets any setting
- [config-env] OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES
- [config-env] API_FORCE_IDLE_TIMEOUT

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.178
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [skills-agents] Nested .claude/skills: Nested skill dirs load; clashes show as <dir>:<name>
+ [skills-agents] Nested .claude/ priority: Agent/workflow/output-style closest to cwd wins on collision
~ [config-env] deny: tool-name glob: * denies all; Tool(param:value) matches input params; allow rejects non-MCP
~ [config-env] workflowKeywordTrigger: Explicit phrases only ('run a workflow', 'workflow:'); purple shimmer
~ [workflows-tips] Dynamic workflows: Orchestrates tens–hundreds of agents; triggers on 'run a workflow', 'workflow:'

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.176
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] language: Pin session title language (overrides auto-detection)
+ [config-env] footerLinksRegexes: Regex-matched link badges in footer row (user or managed)
- [config-env] wheelScrollAccelerationEnabled
- [config-env] terminalSequence

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.175
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] enforceAvailableModels: Managed setting; availableModels constrains Default model, prevents widening

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.174
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] wheelScrollAccelerationEnabled: Disable mouse-wheel scroll acceleration in fullscreen mode
- [config-env] ~/.claude/themes/
- [config-env] defaultEnabled

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.172
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [skills-agents] Nesting depth: Sub-agents can spawn their own sub-agents up to 5 levels deep

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.169
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [cli-flags] --safe-mode: Start with all customizations disabled (CLAUDE.md, plugins, skills, hooks, MCP)
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE: Env var equivalent of --safe-mode flag
+ [slash-commands] /cd [path]: Move session to new working directory without breaking prompt cache
+ [config-env] disableBundledSkills: Hide bundled skills, workflows, and built-in slash commands from model
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS: Env var equivalent of disableBundledSkills setting
+ [config-env] API_FORCE_IDLE_TIMEOUT: Opt out of default 5min idle timeout on Vertex/Foundry (set to 0)
~ [cli-flags] claude agents --json: List live sessions as JSON; --all includes completed; id/state fields
- [config-env] MessageDisplay
- [config-env] reloadSkills
- [config-env] sessionTitle
- [config-env] WorktreeCreate

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.166
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] fallbackModel: Up to 3 fallback models tried in order when primary is overloaded
+ [config-env] deny: tool-name glob: * denies all tools; allow rules reject non-MCP globs
+ [cli-flags] --thinking: disabled turns off thinking on models that think by default
~ [cli-flags] --fallback-model: Fallback when primary unavailable (interactive + headless)
~ [config-env] MAX_THINKING_TOKENS: 0=off; disables thinking on models that think by default
- [config-env] pluginSuggestionMarketplaces
- [config-env] allowAllClaudeAiMcps

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.163
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [slash-commands] /plugin list [--enabled|--disabled]: List installed plugins with status filters
+ [config-env] requiredMinimumVersion / requiredMaximumVersion: Managed settings; refuses start if version outside allowed range
+ [config-env] hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: Stop/SubagentStop: give Claude feedback, continue turn
+ [skills-agents] \$: Escape literal $ before digit in command bodies
~ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID: Session ID passed to stdio MCP server subprocesses (also on --resume)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.162
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

~ [cli-flags] claude agents --json: List live sessions as JSON; includes waitingFor for blocked sessions

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.158
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE: Enable auto mode on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry for Opus 4.7/4.8
~ [workflows-tips] Auto mode: Built-in for Max; Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry via CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE
- [config-env] OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.157
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [cli-flags] claude plugin init <name>: Scaffold a new plugin in .claude/skills
+ [config-env] workflowKeywordTrigger: Toggle 'workflow' keyword triggering dynamic workflows
+ [config-env] OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS: Include tool params (bash cmds, MCP/skill names) in OTEL
+ [workflows-tips] EnterWorktree (switch): Switch between Claude-managed worktrees mid-session
~ [skills-agents] .claude/skills/<name>/: Project skills (auto-loaded as plugins)
- [cli-flags] claude project purge [path]
- [config-env] worktree.bgIsolation
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP
